verdict.rationale: Wise's docs say businesses without financial licenses can offer accounts to their customers. They also document creating accounts in 160+ countries, multi-currency accounts in up to 56 currencies, embeddable Wise-hosted flows (iframe/WebView), and letting customers claim accounts created on their behalf. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the licensing/regulatory model and partner obligations, and independent or hands-on corroboration that developers have shipped embedded accounts this way.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer embedded banking accounts to my customers without holding my own financial license

citations.quote: How businesses without financial licenses can offer accounts for their customers.
Embedded Flows are Wise-hosted flows that partners can open for their users or embed inside their own product with an iframe or mobile WebView.
Allow a customer to take ownership of an account created on their behalf.
The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
